column3: “Twelfth year” replaces eleventh year, and “eleventh month” supplies the month number.
“Villages on her mainland” interprets daughters in the field.
“Villages of your mainland” interprets daughters in the field; shields is plural instead of singular.
“Axes” replaces swords; battering rams renders a singular ram.
“Army” supplies the subject of entering; wagons renders wheels.
“Seafaring men” specifies settlement from the seas; “all peoples” replaces all her inhabitants.
“Coastlands” renders the first islands; demise renders departure.
The closing I will set splendor in the land of the living becomes a negated statement about the city being set in splendor.
